description: This file defines an interface 'Psr17FactoryInterface' in the Slim Framework, specifying static methods for obtaining and checking the availability of PSR-17 factories and creators related to HTTP messaging.

classes.name: Psr17FactoryInterface
classes.description: Interface defining static methods to retrieve HTTP message factories and creators in the Slim Framework, including checks for their availability and instantiation.

methods.name: getResponseFactory
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of ResponseFactoryInterface for creating HTTP responses.

methods.name: getStreamFactory
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of StreamFactoryInterface for creating stream objects.

methods.name: getServerRequestCreator
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of ServerRequestCreatorInterface for creating server request objects.

methods.name: isResponseFactoryAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the ResponseFactory is available.

methods.name: isStreamFactoryAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the StreamFactory is available.

methods.name: isServerRequestCreatorAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the ServerRequestCreator is available.
